title: Molecule inventory
description: The reusable section arrangements the design kit declares. Deliberately pipeline-side and NOT promoted to contract/schemas/: kit.json is a strict DesignSpecIR (additionalProperties:false at its root) and this inventory cannot live inside it. One entry becomes one TreeIR fragment, one saved block pattern, and one piece of the instance's vocabulary.

id.description: Slug fragment. The saved pattern is agent/<kit_id>-<id>, and the companion caps that whole slug at 64 characters.

role.description: The brief section role this molecule serves. Every role used by a brief section must have at least one molecule.

when_to_use.description: One sentence a site editor would understand. Becomes the saved pattern's description.

blocks.description: The core blocks the arrangement is built from, outermost first. core/ only: an atom is a recomposition or a registered block style (ladder rungs 1-2), never a new block.

layout.description: How the children sit. Same vocabulary the brief's per-section design plan uses.

notes.description: The structural detail that makes this arrangement itself and not its neighbour: which child dominates, where the gap falls, what alignment carries the rhythm.

style_refs.description: Slugs the kit declares in tokens_candidates. SLUGS ONLY — a literal here is the same defect as a literal in the fragment.

region_id.description: Optional: the kit region this molecule realizes, when one region is its home.
